blocks.text: VALENCIA CITY, Bukidnon — A 54-year-old farmer died after being gored in the head by an agitated carabao while plowing a field in Barangay Pinamaloy, Don Carlos, Bukidnon, on Tuesday afternoon. Police identified the victim as a resident of Purok Mabuhay, Barangay Pinamaloy. He was rushed to the hospital in neighboring Maramag town but was declared dead on arrival by the attending physician due to severe head injuries. An initial investigation by the Don Carlos Municipal Police Station (MPS) revealed that the incident occurred at around 3:40 p.m. in Purok Malinawon, Barangay Pinamaloy.
